criteria.detail: Committed changes remove authored case-insensitive references across Action Topbar, the catalog, and Dockside, with automated source-audit evidence.
Package, plugin, catalog, and README metadata use direct product-owned language while retaining the matching core and SDK 0.4.33 warning.
Committed browser evidence identifies the light asset as a real BB capture showing the topbar, searchable launcher, and draggable Action rows.
Committed browser evidence identifies the dark asset as the matched real BB state with the topbar and launcher visible.
Both 1450 by 720 PNGs use stable docs/media paths and descriptive theme-specific alt text covering the topbar, launcher, and draggable context.
Committed evidence records 24 tests, typechecking, distribution and authored-source audits, build success, and root repository checks.

securityCorrectness: No executable security regression is introduced; the inspected real-UI assets contain no credentials or sensitive content, and compatibility constraints remain explicit.
designMaintainability: Direct product language, stable shared media paths, accessible documentation, and the automated wording audit provide a focused and maintainable implementation.
